provenance.rights_note: Painted FIST11 punch redraw uses already project-owned original FIST03 godfist_master.webp and impact_master.webp as licensed first-party painted pigment and fist silhouette, then uniquely paints jittered directional blood qi ribbons, crimson highlights and localized impact. No external commercial JX/VL sprites, reused game screen, rig or GIF frames. First-party derivative composite, NOT a newly ImageGen-painted master.
provenance.known_source_limitation: FIST03 first-party painted masters reinterpreted as crimson infernal energy for FIST11; distinctive streamers and impact composited offline. Not a uniquely ImageGen-painted or independently hand-painted source master. Do not declare art PASS until 1x native review.

master_files.role: Source painterly fist silhouette and metal-like knuckle light, remapped to garnet rose-white nether pigment
Source crater pigment; original red-ink collision drawing after source material recoloring and organic mask composition

atlases.layer: Eight original-composite blood qi spirals gather at caster palm; no VFX actor content
Twelve painted garnet-fist/organic red-ink streamers; one directed travelling strike, no screen-wide projectile
Ten rose-white and dark-crimson short-lived contact impacts on moving foe, not actual damage receipt

time_contract.demo_clock_warning: Flight .45-.82s is demo distance/speed approximation, not an observed Combat V2 hit. One synthetic local collision at .82s; no HP mutation, no real status, no false V6.3 enable. Cinematic fade to 1.54s.
time_contract.key_pose_budget_note: 8 original-composite RGBA gather poses, 12 actual-flight painted poses, 10 local contact painted poses, no rig and no GIF. Distinct directional blood-ink motifs, not recoloring same atlas alone.

moving_target.contact_anchor: LAB.contact_at(0,t) follows foe_at(t) - 103px, not the spawn point
moving_target.tracking_rule: Caster and foe WALK independently; punch_at(t) recalculates trajectory toward foe_at(t) each frame. One target, no fake second hit.

proof_contract.source: Huyet Liet Quyen actual moving single-target Crimson fist, LAB synthetic impact only, not gameplay hit.
